themes.name: 肥遺（六足四翼蛇）
reviewNotes: R02 removes unintended reference goggles and differentiates the aubergine hairstyle. Front view shows four arms and two legs, an explicit creative adaptation of six source feet. Four wing membranes are readable in front; overlaps in the second view remain a counting limitation.
Scale pattern is denser than the production masters; retain as candidate, not approved final.

themes.name: 文鰩魚
reviewNotes: Fish scales, fin ears, bird wings, white head and red fin accents are visible and consistent across both angles.

The source red beak is interpreted as red fin accents while retaining a human mouth; this is a deliberate adaptation, not a literal red beak. Feather and hair interiors remain more detailed than the source portraits.

themes.name: 天狗
reviewNotes: White-headed youthful human face with organic rounded beast ears and tail; expressive angular brows and open mouth. No long red tengu nose or bird wings.
Source 狸 is a historical animal description; modern tanuki-like ears are a design choice, not a zoological identification.

themes.name: 畢方
reviewNotes: Both full-body views visibly have one central bird leg and one foot; teal/red feathers grow from the back.
White beak is interpreted via ivory feather/keratin accents; no literal beak. Ear feather/jaw ridge separation and interior line density remain candidates for refinement.

themes.name: 英招
reviewNotes: Actual output visually inspected. R02 simplifies eyes to flat amber/solid black and hides visible duplicated human ears, simplifies hair and wing interiors.
Young male identity, green/ivory/rust outfit, real horse ears and tail, tiger skin markings and bird wings persist across front and three-quarter-back views.
Two views are one raster sheet, not separate angle files; no vectorization claimed.
Outer RGB preview shows brown/cream glow; sampled background is checked through alpha and source PNG is retained unmodified.
Tight silhouette clearance near upper and lateral edges is below the requested 5%; retain as reviewed candidate, not user-approved final.

themes.name: 陸吾
reviewNotes: R03 adds two distinguishable cream-tipped tiger tails to the far-right lower portion of the right three-quarter figure; all nine visible tips can now be counted in each view.

Approximate 1536x1024 tail-tip centers for the right view: (1170,48), (990,170), (912,335), (890,553), (910,712), (1005,866), (1488,420), (1497,755), (1495,908). The last two are the requested additions.
The left front view retains nine visible tail tips. Face, expression, clothing, hand pose and overall identity appear visually consistent with R02. Pixel-identical preservation is not claimed.
Some tail roots remain naturally occluded by the jacket and body. The result passes visible-tip counting; complete tracing of every root to the anatomical origin cannot be independently seen.
True transparent alpha verified from PNG data; the dark brown RGB visible in some viewers exists beneath zero-alpha background pixels. No pixel edits were applied.

Rendering retains near-black contours, flat cel shading and warm peach skin; some fur/hair interior texture remains denser than the production portrait masters. This is an unapproved candidate, not a user-approved final.

themes.name: 開明獸
reviewNotes: Two separately generated views each show one central face and four faces on either side; all nine have organic neck connections to one torso.
Parent and generation agent manually inspected both outputs. Style remains candidate: extra hair shading and skin modulation; no user approval.
R04 simplifies the previous diagonal shoulder sash to a waist sash consistently across both views.
R03 was a localized request to preserve the existing seven heads and add two; both returned views still contain seven. Count remains failed after two correction attempts.
All visible heads are living human-faced branches of the torso, not masks or emblems. Youthful human identity, tiger-marked necks and clothing stay consistent.
Keep R01-R03 as historical candidate iterations. Do not count this item as complete or publish it to the website.

themes.name: 西王母
reviewNotes: Generated image visually inspected in tool output: youthful female identity remains consistent across frontal and three-quarter-back views.
Both views retain actual leopard tail, visible tiger canines, long unruly dark-plum hair and small pale jade sheng ornament. No invented wings, horns or animal ears.

R02 eyes are simplified flat olive with solid black pupils; outlines stronger and long hair reduced to broader blocks. Hair remains more elaborate than short-haired production portraits because this identity requires long dishevelled hair.
RGB preview includes hidden halo colors; sampled exterior alpha is checked and output retained unchanged. No scripted pixel editing.
Upper/lateral clearance remains tighter than requested 5%; full tail curve and hair silhouette are visible. Record as reviewed candidate, not user-approved final.
One raster PNG contains two views; no separate angle exports or vectorization claimed.

themes.name: 羬羊
reviewNotes: The requested ear correction hides the frontal human pinnae under hair; a small apparent human pinna still remains behind the cheek in the three-quarter view. Sheep horns, sheep ears and horse tail remain consistent, but the no-extra-ear requirement is not fully passed.
Unresolved extra-ear anatomy in three-quarter view. Do not mark character qualified or publish to website.
Margin improved: alpha >=128 bounding box (129,31,1260,1171) on a 1312x1199 canvas; tail is inside the frame with 52px right margin.
Wool can still read as fur cuff rather than skin-grown wool.
Exact curled horn shape, palette, human age/gender and profession are original inventions, not stated by the source.
Facial line density is reduced by full-body framing; additional head detail sheet may be useful later.
Some hair and cloth shading is finer than the production portraits; remains candidate, not accepted final.

themes.name: 䳋渠
reviewNotes: Both views keep the same identity, dark organic feather regions/tail and two exposed red bird feet. Framing edit brought the right tail point within the canvas.
Complete right tail point now fits, with only 17px right margin at alpha >=128 (requested 6% margin not fully achieved).
Some feather shoulders still read as epaulettes; organic forearm feathers and bird feet are the clearer body transformations.
Ear/crest details blend into black hair. Age/gender, attire and scout role are original design choices.
Hair and feather line density exceed the production portraits in places; candidate needs style review.

completionRule: All in-scope identities must first be resolved from the 18 chapter audits; each then needs actually generated and visually checked consistent two-angle assets plus confirmed Figma and GitHub archives. 716 provisional index records are not a final character total. Superseded candidates and unresolved anatomy do not count as final artwork.

artDirection.beauty: All handsome boys/young men and beautiful girls/young women; vary youthful age and facial structure. No rough middle-aged or elderly faces.
artDirection.hybrid: Actual yokai anatomy integrated with beautiful human silhouette, not merely clothing symbols. Preserve each source creature identifying features.
artDirection.reference: Onmyoji Arena character-concept fusion; deployed portraits control raster rendering.
artDirection.oldBatch: All R01 and Mi R02 from before correction are legacy candidates, not compliant final delivery.
